text: 毕马威发布《中国内地及香港IPO市场2026年第三季回顾》显示，目前活跃上市申请已超过600宗，香港有望录得历来最强劲的年度集资表现，全年集资额有机会达到5000亿港元。 毕马威称，香港首次公开招股(IPO)市场创下历来首9个月集资新高，共有116宗新股上市，集资总额突破3880亿港元，为去年同期的两倍以上。随着市场势头持续强劲，香港有望打破2010年创下的4270亿港元年度集资纪录，创下历来最高年度集资额。 A+H上市继续成为香港IPO市场的主要增长引擎。期内共有37宗A+H上市，数目为去年同期的三倍以上，集资额亦增长逾180%，占香港IPO集资总额近
text_en: KPMG released its "Mainland China and Hong Kong IPO Markets Q3 2026 Review," showing that there are currently more than 600 active listing applications, and Hong Kong is expected to record its strongest annual fundraising performance ever, with full-year fundraising potentially reaching HK$500 billion. KPMG said Hong Kong's initial public offering (IPO) market set a record high for fundraising in the first nine months of any year, with 116 new listings raising more than HK$388 billion, more than double the same period last year. With market momentum remaining strong, Hong Kong is expected to break the annual fundraising record of HK$427 billion set in 2010 and set its highest annual fundraising amount ever. A+H listings continued to be the main growth engine of Hong Kong's IPO market.
